Best Age for Your Child's First Dental Visit

A parent's guide to pediatric dental care in Ahmedabad — when to start, what to expect, and preventing cavities early.

Dr. Siddharth Mehta
BDS MDS · Implant & Laser Dentist, Ahmedabad
📍 Shyamal Cross Road, Ahmedabad🕐 5 min read🦷 Expert Dental Article

When Should My Child First See a Dentist?

Gentle pediatric dental care — Dr. Siddharth's Dental Care, Ahmedabad

The American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry recommends a child's first dental visit by age 1, or within 6 months of the first tooth appearing — much earlier than most Ahmedabad parents expect.

Why so early?

  • Catches feeding habits that could cause early decay (like bottle at night)
  • Familiarises the child with the dental chair — reduces fear later
  • Allows monitoring of jaw and teeth development
  • Parents get personalised guidance on brushing technique

What happens at the first visit?

It's gentle and brief — usually just a visual check, a chat with parents about home care, and sometimes a 'happy visit' with no actual treatment, just familiarisation.

Child-friendly dental environment — our clinic, Ahmedabad

Common childhood dental problems in Ahmedabad

  • Baby bottle tooth decay — from prolonged bottle feeding, especially at night
  • Thumb sucking — can affect bite alignment if continued past age 4-5
  • Early cavities — sugary snacks and inconsistent brushing
  • Teeth grinding — common in young children, usually resolves on its own

Tips for parents

  • Start brushing as soon as the first tooth appears — soft-bristled brush, rice-grain amount of fluoride toothpaste
  • Avoid putting child to sleep with a milk bottle
  • Limit sugary snacks and juices between meals
  • Bring children for checkups every 6 months once a dentist visit routine starts
